title: bug: real CI on PR #230 is red at the tip, on windows-latest only: subagent-mirror.test.mjs "PowerShell 7: B: any other copy failure still stops the pre-flight" matches /is denied/ against pwsh 7's ConciseView error, which the runner wraps mid-message with ANSI codes ("...one.md' is" / "| denied."), so the Windows job stops at step 13 of 23 and steps 14-23 never run on CI
description:
Filed by the governor (governor-e6142a94) on 2026-11-04, from real GitHub CI, not a dry run.

PROBLEM
- ci.yml runs on PR #230 (moe/work-2026-10-24 into main) at every landing. A newer push replaces only the queued run, so a run completes about every 45-50 min.
- Every completed run today has failed.
  - The earlier reds have been fixed: installers (7e862808), literal paths (6b3ab9d8) and serena-ignore (e45da220).
  - Since 2037e856 exactly ONE step is red, on windows-latest only: "Test launcher daemon.json cap and seat re-registration".
- Inside that step one test fails:
  - scripts/tests/subagent-mirror.test.mjs, case "PowerShell 7: B: any other copy failure still stops the pre-flight". The stack points at :192:12, which is `assert.match(r.out, engine.ext === 'sh' ? /Permission denied/ : /is denied/)`.
  - On the runner, pwsh 7 prints the Copy-Item error in ConciseView, with ANSI colour and a "     | " gutter, wrapped at the console width.
  - The runner's 8.3 temp path C:\Users\RUNNER~1\AppData\Local\Temp\moe-mirror-XXXXXX\project\.claude\agents\one.md pushes the break between "is" and "denied.", so the regex never matches.
  - PowerShell 5.1 (NormalView) and Git Bash pass. Hunt #22's local Windows dry run passed this step (169 tests, 156 pass) because its temp path wraps elsewhere. A dry run cannot catch this.
- Consequence: GitHub stops the job at the first failed step, so Windows steps 14-23 have not run on CI in any completed run today:
  - the PowerShell .moe-agent.json read and daemon autostart arguments;
  - the Bash, Windows PowerShell and PowerShell 7 landing guards and wrapper postflights;
  - VS Code daemon startup, and packaging the VS Code extension.
  Latent reds there stay hidden until this is fixed.

EVIDENCE (gh.exe run view <id> --json jobs / --log-failed)
- Run 41823611051 at 2037e856 and run 41830422144 at 060d7b8c both completed as failure. Their only failed job is "Build (windows-latest)", failing at "Test launcher daemon.json cap and seat re-registration": 169 tests, 155 pass, 1 fail, 13 skipped.
- Run 41834653023 at 80078651: Build (windows-latest) failed at the same step. macOS, JetBrains, fresh Linux install, Build TypeScript and Test TypeScript are all green.
- The assertion's actual input, from 41830422144, with ANSI shortened to <E>:
  `Get-ChildItem: C:\Users\runneradmin\...\seat.ps1:25` / `Line |` / `25 | Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $moeAgentsDir -File -Filter "*.md" …` / `| Access to the path 'C:\Users\RUNNER~1\AppData\Local\Temp\moe-mirror-vTPP70\project\.claude\agents\one.md' is<E>` / `<E>| <E>denied.<E>`
  Note that the error record comes from Get-ChildItem at seat.ps1:25, not from Copy-Item.

FIX DIRECTION, test-side. The wrapper's behaviour is right: the pre-flight stops.
- Before matching, normalize the child's output for the ps1 engines:
  - strip ANSI (/\x1B\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]/g);
  - drop ConciseView's gutter and line breaks (for example replace /\r?\n\s*\|?\s*/g with ' ');
  - collapse whitespace.
  Then match /is denied/, or /Access to the path .* is denied/.
- Alternatively, run the fixture's pwsh with `$PSStyle.OutputRendering = 'PlainText'` and `$ErrorView = 'NormalView'`. But normalizing in the test also covers a future wrap anywhere.
- Apply the same normalization to every other regex or includes() assertion in this file that reads pwsh error text.
- Scan the sibling launcher tests run in the same CI step (seat-registration, daemon-json-cap) for the same pattern: a pwsh 7 error string matched across a possible wrap.
- Do not edit scripts/moe-agent.ps1 or moe-agent.sh. CQ-M07s holds moe-agent.ps1, and the bug is in the test.

REPRODUCE LOCALLY. pwsh.exe and powershell.exe are on the Windows host, and hunt #22's scripts in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-7a3640da/mine/ show the Windows clean-env setup.
- Either force the same wrap by pointing TEMP/TMP at a directory whose path is as long as the runner's, or longer, so the message breaks before "denied.",
- or add a fixture case that feeds the captured string above through the normalizer.
- Show the red-then-green either way.

planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
Measured on this host 2026-11-04; the RED reproduced locally at the CI line.
- Consoles: node.exe launched from WSL bash gives pwsh.exe 7.6.9 a console of width 120 with ErrorView ConciseView and OutputRendering Host, which writes SGR codes into the redirected stderr. powershell.exe 5.1 has width 120 and NormalView. WSL node with Linux pwsh 7.6.9 has width 80.
- pwsh 7 wrap: the ConciseView message line is a 7-char gutter, then "Access to the path '" (20) + path + "' is denied." (12), wrapped at the last space before the console width. The path is TEMP + 48 chars, so at width 120 a TEMP of 34-41 chars breaks between 'is' and 'denied.'. The runner's TEMP is 36 chars. This host's default is 33, one short, which is why hunt #22's local run passed. Under a 46-char TEMP pwsh 7 breaks before the path instead and the old test passes, so the TEMP length matters.
- 5.1 wrap: 5.1 prefixes 'Get-ChildItem : ' and, at the runner's length, breaks before the quoted path. Its FullyQualifiedErrorId line also char-breaks inside the path. So the old /is denied/ passed on 5.1 only because of where the break fell.
- Source of the record: the stub's throw surfaces from the Get-ChildItem | ForEach-Object pipeline at moe-agent.ps1:1186, hence the 'Get-ChildItem:' header at seat.ps1:25.
- Environment: TEMP reaches node.exe only through WSLENV (TEMP/w:TMP/w). Linux os.tmpdir() reads TMP/TEMP too, so never export them for the Linux leg.
